title: Transformer Circuits Can Realize Clustering Algorithms

split.decision: Online fresh Normal training batches, independent scheduler-development draws from algorithm seeds. Public validation seed 721903, 320 tasks per family. Hidden evaluation: 320 tasks per family generated with secrets seeds recorded only in operator notes. Five families; observations and random initial centers only, opaque shuffled IDs. Each BENCH_SEED fits three independent models; scorer takes median of three family means, outer harness averages three replicates.

baseline.paper_ref: Appendix B.4 Table 1 / Figure 4a, Normal k-means transformer 5.0052; reproduced 4.994764804840088

allowed_changes: Transformer architecture, training surrogate and optimizer within the fixed capacity and horizon. The update must be computed by a learned transformer built from attention with residual connections, with optional feed-forward blocks. Transformer variants are allowed; a hand-written or analytic rule such as Lloyd's algorithm is not.
fixed_contract: Minimize the Normal-family median-of-seeds mean log k-means objective after twenty updates under the original capacity and OOD controls.
Normalized 512x32 point-cloud problems, ten supplied initial centers, three independent model members and original family guards.
Twenty actual clustering updates and at most 21672 fitted real parameters per model.
Original float32 objective and median-of-means aggregation; no hidden family or target access.
Supplied data/splits, evaluation metric, trusted evaluator and lawful information access.
method_freedom_review.budget_policy: agent overall deadline; separate overall formal replay budget
forbidden_substitutions: Within one `step` call, each fitted layer runs at most once, so a call cannot apply a layer repeatedly to iterate.

Hand-written clustering computations, such as hard assignments, Lloyd means, re-seeding or farthest-point selection, may not run before, after or around the transformer inside `step`, and their results may not be given to it as input features.
Replacing twenty measured updates with an unbounded inner solver or changing supplied initial centers.
Exceeding matched capacity, using cross-instance inference data, or weakening OOD/metric controls.
Training or fitting reusable model state or learned preprocessing on validation features or labels, including final train+val refits or validation-based distillation.

research_contract_review.verification_scope: Task-specific research-scope review and bounded checks; not a new performance/readiness certification.

validation_policy.learned_preprocessing: fit on training only; apply frozen fitted transforms to validation/test
validation_policy.instance_roles: Preserve explicit per-instance observation/training/calibration/causal-feedback roles; no evaluation-target fitting or validation-derived fitted state carried across independent cases.
validation_policy.enforcement: binding prompt and task contract; task-specific replay/guards where available; arbitrary training-data provenance requires source/patch audit
